thought.text: Let me test the login page and verify authentication works end-to-end.

reasoning_content: I'm checking the authentication mechanism and verifying the password hash against known candidates. The login cookie appears to be a fixed token from the configuration, so I should test whether that works directly, and I need to identify what password corresponds to the stored hash.

action.command: cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && COOKIE=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('appsettings.json'))['Bovis.Web']['AuthCookie'])"); echo "cookie=$COOKIE"; echo "=== /login no auth ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/login.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5195/login; grep -o -E "(Anmeldung|Anmelden|falsch|Benutzer)" /tmp/login.html | sort -u; echo "=== / with admin cookie ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/home.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app"; grep -o -E "(Liste der Dienste|Administrationsrechten|BoVis|edit_html|edit_bl|edit_sel)" /tmp/home.html | sort -u
